title: Dependency and interpreter version conflicts
summary: Requires-Dist version specifiers and Requires-Python constrain compatible versions. A present package can still breach a dependency contract; conflicting requirements need reproducible resolution inputs.
checks: Compare normalized installed versions against every active requirement and the cfg Python version.
Review lock/constraint intent independently; build a disposable replacement before any deployment decision.
limitations: No dependency solver, installer or remediation executor runs; metadata cannot establish runtime compatibility.
applicability: POSIX CPython venv metadata for Python 3.11-3.14; static evidence only
